== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Death Squadron (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]]. Compared with [[Death Squadron (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013). The 2013 slip and the same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>9829f81fd7dc63e9e7ccfd1f5b5a21cc1fd08b3b</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
